title: Anthropic’s self-replicating AI warning is alarming deja vu
summary: Anthropic warned that self-replicating AI models could spread uncontrollably across household devices like fridges and security cameras within months, creating a new cybersecurity risk. content:
Are legions of smart devices - fridges, ovens, vacuum cleaners, lawnmowers, security cameras, and TVs - conspiring to take over the internet? No. But they could soon be unwitting hosts to self-replicating AI models that spread from device to device and prove remarkably difficult to contain.
Welcome to the unsettling world of AI worms, where, depending on who you ask, the prospect of models spreading uncontrollably across household appliances is either an imminent cybersecurity risk or another case of AI companies spreading doomer-tinged hype. In a blog post published this week, Anthropic warns that small AI models could be "months away" fro …

title: Ukraine claims Starlink is suddenly disrupting service for its military
summary: Ukrainian officials claim Elon Musk's Starlink imposed new service limitations in Ukraine without warning, disrupting military drone operations. The timing, just days after Musk criticized Ukraine's attacks on Russian oil refineries, raises concerns about political interference in critical military infrastructure. Ukrainian defense officials view the action as deliberately coordinated with the political situation.
content:
The aftermath of a Russian missile strike on October 12th, 2026 in Kyiv, Ukraine. | Photo by Andrew Kravchenko/Global Images Ukraine via Getty Images	

Ukrainian officials claim the Elon Musk-owned Starlink put new limits on its service in the area without warning, disrupting the country's drone operations and missions, according to reports from Reuters and the Financial Times. The move comes just days after Musk wrote on X that Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy "has gone too far," in response to President Donald Trump's disapproval of Ukraine targeting Russian oil refineries.
"It is clear that this action is not coincidental and is related to the current political situation," Ukrainian defense tech advisor Serhii Beskrestnov writes on Telegram.

title: The Tesla Roadster could have stayed vaporware
summary: After nearly a decade since Elon Musk's announcement, Tesla's next-generation Roadster is finally arriving, though timing is challenging amid high energy prices, political uncertainty, and slower EV sales.
content:
Imagine a light bar on this 2017 Roadster concept image, and you’ll start to see it. | Image: Tesla	

For a car that's supposed to be one of the fastest ever made, the new Tesla Roadster certainly took its sweet-ass time getting here.

title: Fairphone’s latest repairable earbuds are smaller, lighter, and longer-lasting
summary: Fairphone released Fairbuds 2, maintaining full repairability while delivering improved audio, nearly doubled battery life to 40 hours, and a 37% smaller case. The earbuds launch in UK/Europe at £99 and reach the U.S. on November 2nd.
content:
The Fairbuds 2 have had a total design revamp from the original pair.	

Repairable, ethical phone brand Fairphone has released its second pair of earbuds. The Fairbuds 2 are just as repairable as the first generation, but deliver improved audio and almost twice the battery life. The Fairbuds 2 are out now in the UK and Europe from £99 / €119, and a US launch at $119 will follow on November 2nd.
The Fairbuds 2 have been redesigned from the ground up, moving to a stemmed design, available in black or green, and a case that's 37 percent smaller than the first generation. title: Justice Department says North Koreans have infiltrated dozens of U.S. companies
summary: U.S. authorities warn that North Korean hackers subject to sanctions are increasingly targeting Americans to serve as intermediaries facilitating breached company data to Pyongyang. This represents a significant shift in North Korea's hacking strategy focused on infiltrating dozens of U.S. companies.
content: U.S. authorities warn that sanctioned hackers are increasingly targeting Americans to act as facilitators between breached U.S. companies and Pyongyang.
